meta.title: MCP Server Settings
meta.description: Adds an MCP servers settings page with configuration editing, live connection status, saved-configuration tests, and restart controls.

ui.actionFailed: The action could not be completed. Refresh and try again. Your draft has been kept.
ui.argsHint: For example: ["--server", "notes"]. The command is started directly, not through a shell.
ui.cleanupFailed: The test connection could not be confirmed closed. Restart the app before trying again.
ui.conflict: The saved server changed while you were editing. Cancel and reopen the editor to review the latest configuration. Your draft has been kept.
ui.credentialHelp: Use ${credential:REF} to reference credentials already saved in this app. Literal secrets are stored as plain text in your profile. Connection tests use the saved configuration, not this draft.
ui.duplicate: This server name is already in use.
ui.empty: No MCP servers configured. Add a server to connect its tools.
ui.envHint: For example: {"API_KEY":"${credential:MY_API_KEY}"}. Values are hidden by default.
ui.headersHint: For example: {"Authorization":"Bearer ${credential:MY_API_KEY}"}. Values are hidden by default.
ui.inheritedHelp: Servers supplied by the default configuration can be edited or disabled, but not deleted here.
ui.intro: Connect tools from local or remote MCP servers. Changes apply to the running server configuration.
ui.invalid: Check the name and required fields. Arguments must be a JSON string array, environment variables and headers JSON string objects. Only ${credential:REF} templates are supported.
ui.loadFailed: MCP servers could not be loaded. Try refreshing.
ui.name: Server name
ui.nameHint: 1–32 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens. The name is permanent and prefixes tool names.
ui.pluginHelp: Plugin-managed servers can be tested or restarted. Their configuration is owned by the plugin.
ui.probeFailed: Connection test failed. Check the saved configuration and credentials, then retry.
ui.removeMessage: Remove {name} and disconnect its tools? Shared credentials will not be removed.
ui.title: MCP servers
ui.urlHint: An http:// or https:// MCP endpoint. The saved URL is hidden to protect embedded credentials.
ui.watchFailed: Live status is unavailable. Refresh to reconnect.
ui.workspace.intro: Hide MCP servers from agents that run in this workspace. Servers keep running for other workspaces.
ui.workspace.loadFailed: Could not load this workspace's settings.
ui.workspace.saveFailed: Could not save the workspace setting. Try again.
ui.workspace.watchFailed: Could not read the MCP server list. Retrying…
